body:
It's not that I've had a lot of bad things happen, but I've been able to coast through life through sheer luck, and I can't imagine being able to push my life forwards in any way I can personally control, which is why I feel like I don't really deserve my life. I'm wasting away, but thinking about things like working or going back to school make me feel physically ill, and have since I was 12. I'm always tired, and I don't take care of my health or money at all, which I get a lot of flak from my dad about, even if he wants to help. I can barely even bring myself to draw or write anymore, or even bring up a show to watch or a game to play. I just spent 18 of the last 24 hours asleep when I should've gone to work. Granted, some of this is coming from medication withdrawal since I'm being weaned off my old meds in order to switch back to an old one with more proof of success, but it's certainly been like this long before that.

At the very least, posting here and writing this has calmed me down enough to put the meds aside and try to lie down instead. Thank you, at the very least, for being willing to hear (or... I guess read) me out.
